about: TEMPLATE — copy this file to goldset.json and replace the examples with 8 questions about YOUR my_kb/ documents: 6 with answerable=true and 2 with answerable=false. The notebook warns you if an evidence phrase is not in your documents word-for-word.

how_to_fill_this_in.question: how someone would really ask it, not a keyword search
how_to_fill_this_in.source: which my_kb file answers it (null for the 2 unanswerable ones)
how_to_fill_this_in.evidence: one short phrase copied WORD-FOR-WORD from that file. Keep it under ~80 characters and on one line, or a small chunk size will cut it in half. Leave empty for unanswerable questions.

questions.question: EXAMPLE — delete this. What does the cloud shared responsibility model make the customer responsible for?
evidence: a short phrase copied word-for-word from your_document.md

questions.question: EXAMPLE — delete this. The OFF-TOPIC question: something clearly outside cybersecurity, e.g. What is the capital of France?

EXAMPLE — delete this. The SOUNDS-RIGHT-BUT-ABSENT question: squarely on your topic and phrased like your other questions, but genuinely not covered by any file in my_kb/. This is the one that tests whether your bot knows what it does not know — choose it on purpose and say why in your report.
